integrity: The proof uses exact diagonalization plus elementary geometric sums and finite/infinite cyclic equidistribution. Computational checks are finite and do not establish asymptotics. No external validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Fixed m,n>=2, common radial damping, unimodular fixed phases only; no uniformity in varying phase. The known monomial gcd reduction is not original. Historical equivalent special cases could exist; relevant 2017 publisher full text not inspected.
title: Arithmetic phase residues for radially damped monomial composition commutators
